title: Beyond the Leaderboard: Counterfactual Diagnosis of End-to-End and VLA Driving Policies Under Domain Shift
abstract: arXiv:2609.22582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: End-to-end and vision-language-action (VLA) driving policies are compared by leaderboard rank, but a rank reports an outcome, not the behaviour behind it, so it predicts poorly how a policy will behave at a new site. On six released policies, rank on nuScenes open-loop error or on NAVSIM's leaderboard does not carry over to scenes with a pedestrian near the ego corridor at a new site. We propose a counterfactual check-up: a few hundred real frames, each edited two ways (pedestrian removed, or re-lit by a night-style perturbation), every edit verified by an independent detector, and the change in the planned trajectory read as a diagnosis rather than a score. translated_title: 超越排行榜：域偏移下端到端与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驾驶策略的反事实诊断
translated_abstract: 端到端与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驾驶策略通常通过排行榜排名进行比较，但排名只反映结果，而非其背后的行为，因此难以预测策略在新场景中的表现。在六个已发布的策略上，nuScenes开环误差或NAVSIM排行榜上的排名无法延续到新场景中自车走廊附近有行人的情形。我们提出一种反事实体检方法：使用几百帧真实图像，每帧以两种方式进行编辑（移除行人，或施加夜间风格的光照扰动），每次编辑均由独立检测器验证，并将规划轨迹的变化作为诊断依据而非分数。从这些编辑中读出两条因果轴，并据此构建五项测试，将分数所混合的因素区分开来：策略规划行驶的距离、看到行人是否能带来安全、该响应是否随危险程度缩放、在没有要求时规划是否移动，以及……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种反事实诊断方法，通过对真实驾驶帧进行行人移除与夜间光照扰动两种编辑，从规划轨迹变化中提取两条因果轴并构建五项测试，揭示排行榜排名无法预测端到端与VLA驾驶策略在域偏移新场景下的真实行为。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a counterfactual check-up that edits real driving frames (removing pedestrians or applying night-style re-lighting) and reads the resulting trajectory changes as diagnoses, extracting two causal axes and five exams that reveal how leaderboard ranks fail to predict the behavior of end-to-end and VLA driving policies under domain shift.
